items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: after Willie Foster left, I was advancing Mr. Boye-to, he helped me, Philip Boye-to, he helped me, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, I drank it, as long as I didn't eat that olive oil, it would lick a float up on it. Never did that? It wouldn't burn your line in your stone house. You see, them guys wouldn't eat and everything like spooking them, they wouldn't eat, but I ate. Me, I always kept me a hunk of bologna, I said something like that. I'm very sorry about drinking now, but I mean, when I drank, I used to drink. You see, because the Maracas, a lot of them had died out, well all the uncles, they all had established them all up and…
Has Uncle Jim's on Carrollton? Yeah. James LaRocca.
